column1: # China NGCC round-1 signature instances. Columns: see bench-common/ngcc/gen_rules.py.
# One row per ALGORITHM_INSTANCE. Explain non-obvious srcs/defs/patches in a comment line above the row.

# status.tsv was produced per candidate group inside the container (a single full status run is killed by memory pressure). NGCC_KAT_TIMEOUT per group: sign-01..06, 08, 10..13, 15..18, 20..24 and 14/19/21 (rerun): 400 s; sign-05, 18, 28, 29, 31, 33, 34 (final rerun): 300 s; sign-30: 500 s; sign-07, 25: 600 s; sign-26, 27, 32: 600 s; sign-09: no sources. A TIMEOUT row exceeded its group's limit.
# Aigis-Sig+: aigis_sig.c is the vendor speed-test main (needs speed.c/cpucycles.c). randombytes.c reads /dev/urandom; rng.c already routes randombytes() to drng_algorithm, so drop it.

# Parameter set: -DPARAMS=1|2|3 (params.h has no default). KDF: -DUSE_ICCS is the only choice that reproduces the submitted KAT (USE_SM3 and USE_SHA3 give MISMATCH); it routes XOF/hash through the ICCS placeholders pseudoXOF/pseudohash, which status.tsv records as hash=placeholder.
# SM3 comes from the bundled ippcpsm3/ subdirectory, which '*' does not descend into; patches/sign-01/sm3_block.c compiles its UpdateSM3 block function (never included by a .c file upstream).

# Optimised x86 (avx2/ subtree): the AVX2 sources use USE_ICCS like the reference build and need keccak4x/KeccakP-1600-times4-SIMD256.c; the SM3 sources are not used (placeholder hash); aes.c (needs a missing aes.h) and randombytes.c are dropped, rng.c routes randombytes() to drng_algorithm.
# sign-02 BiT-384: not built: the archive has no BiT-384 implementation (only 128/256/512); its claims row comes from the specification.

# Optimised x86 (BiT-<n>-avx2): consts.c is compiled through patches/sign-02/wrap_consts.c (hidden visibility, so the PC-relative asm references link into a shared object). BiT-128 needs -DASM_ALIASES (the .S files define the ntt_avx_* names only then); BiT-256 drops shuffle.S, a leftover that uses an undefined cdecl() macro.

# CEDRUSC, CEDRUSALPHA (sign-04), Flextree (sign-11), sign-17: sign.c defines the NIST-API crypto_sign_* symbols that the shim also exports; the candidate's copies are renamed with -D (defs never reach the shim). Instances whose KAT replay is slow use katn 2 (slow KAT replay).
# Optimised x86 (SM3x8 hashing): same flags as the reference build.

# sm4th/ublockith/vistrutith: the instance header is <instance>_AlgorithmInstance.h; <instance>_bench.c is a benchmark main; utils_* subdirectories hold the primitives ('*' does not descend). The 'tight' and ublock instances need -DUSE_BALLET=1 -DHAVE_BALLET_CORE=1. sm4th_d3_*_tight asserts on an undeclared variable, so it builds with -DNDEBUG. vistrutith_d3_512f katn 2 and _512s katn 1 (slow KAT replay).

# Optimised x86: same flags as the reference build; the loose instances additionally compile utils_sm4/hygon_cis_sm4.c and the two SM4 assembly files and drop the hygon_cis_sm4_probe.c main. vistrutith_d3_512s stays on the reference build (KAT replay TIMEOUT in both).

column1: # Tins: the instance header is SIG_TINS<n>.h. Tins128/Tins512 CRYPTOFAIL (sig_verify rejected) only under our global -O3 -march=native; they pass at the submitter's -O2. We keep the global flags (per-row cflags are parked). katn 1 (slow KAT replay).
# Optimised x86 for Tins256 only (Tins128/Tins512 stay on the reference build: CRYPTOFAIL in both, see above).

# TRINE: exactly one of USE_SHA3/USE_ICCS must be defined and USE_ICCS (placeholder hash) is used; patches/sign-30/api.h declares the NIST-API symbols under their renamed (cand_*) names so the shim's own prototypes do not clash. Keys and signatures are megabytes, so katn is 1-2 (megabyte keys and signatures make replay slow).
# Optimised x86 (Performance_Optimized_Implementation): same flags as the reference build.

# UVW: -DUSE_API_PKC selects the ICCS hash glue. Keys are huge (UVW-512 pk is 95 MB; ngcc_kat cap raised to 256 MiB; UVW-256 and UVW-512 still TIMEOUT at 600 s because key generation is that slow), katn 1 (huge keys: one record is enough and keeps memory bounded).
# Optimised x86 for UVW-128 only (UVW-256/512 stay on the reference build: KAT replay TIMEOUT in both).
# VDOO: -DVDOO_<n> selects the set; vdoo-*.c are alternate copies of the vdoo_*.c files (dropped); api.c is renamed as in sign-03. VDOO-512 katn 1 (slow KAT replay).
# yuanyang: drng_algorithm.c defines drng_algorithm itself (-DNGCC_NO_DRNG for the shim); the ntrugen key generator lives under keygen/.
